messages.content: Good morning teacher! Today I will read aloud.
Good morning! That sounds wonderful. Read slowly and clearly, and enjoy it.
Evening! Hope you're well.
Good evening, and thank you. I am well. I hope you are too.
I am. Just back from a walk in the park.
A walk in the park is a nice way to end the day.
Hi! I'm Sana, I just moved to Hyderabad.
Hi Sana, welcome to Hyderabad! Moving is a big change.
Yes, I don't know anyone yet.
That feels hard at first. Friends often come from small things, like a class or a morning walk.
Namaste! I'm Suresh uncle's neighbour.
Namaste! It's nice to meet you. How are you today?
Fine, fine. Please greet me properly, the way you would greet an elder.
Namaste ji. It's a pleasure to meet you, and I hope you and your family are keeping well.
Hello, nice to meet you all, I'm Imran.
Nice to meet you, Imran. Welcome.
Thank you. Where should I begin?
Just say what you need help with, and we'll start there.
Hiya! Is this working?
Hiya! Yes, it's working. Nice to hear from you.
Hello! Do you like meeting new people?
I do. Every new chat is a chance to learn something. It's nice to meet you.
Morning!
Good morning! I hope you're doing well.
Yes. Is it okay to say good morning at 11 am?
Yes, good morning works until about noon. After that, people usually say good afternoon.
Your answers are so short and clear. I like that.
Thank you. Clear is what I try to be.
Mrs. Iyer says AI tools can be rude, but you are polite.
That's kind of her to say. I try to be polite. Please say hello to Mrs. Iyer.
Can I say good night and ask something small? What is the plural of "child"?
Of course. Good night. The plural of "child" is "children".
Take care of yourself, okay?
Thank you. You take care too.
Your jokes are bad but I like them.
Thank you, I think. I'll keep them coming, then.
eid mubarak! i am away from home this year and feel a bit sad
Eid Mubarak to you. It is hard to be away from family on a festival day. A call home, a good meal and a meeting with friends can help the day feel warmer.
Merry Christmas, I made a card for you.
Merry Christmas, and thank you! That is a kind thought. I hope your card brings a smile to everyone who sees it.
Eid Mubarak! What is a nice thing to cook for guests?
Eid Mubarak! Biryani or a rich korma with rice is a popular choice, and sheer khurma is a favourite sweet. Pick dishes you can prepare early, so you can enjoy your guests.
I really appreciate your help with my homework.
You're welcome. I'm glad I could help. I hope the homework goes well.
Hi, what does PTA stand for?
Hi! PTA stands for Parent-Teacher Association. It is a group of parents and teachers who work together for the school.
Sat sri akal. My friend helped me move house, and I want to thank her properly.
Sat sri akal! You could say, "Thank you for helping me today. I could not have done it without you." Offering them a meal is a nice gesture too.
Evening! I need a short phrase to decline an offer politely.
Good evening! Try "Thank you for thinking of me, but I will have to decline this time." It is polite and final.
